banner.message: This browser cannot save directly to files. “Save” downloads the file instead. Use Chrome or Edge for direct saving.
banner.description: Warning banner for browsers that cannot write to files directly (Firefox, Safari). "Save" refers to the Save button; Chrome and Edge are browser names (keep them).

new.description: Top-bar button: create a new empty document in a new tab.

open.description: Top-bar button: open one or more Markdown files.

save.description: Top-bar button: save the current document to its file.

saveAs.description: Top-bar button: save the current document under a new file name.

undo.description: Top-bar button with a leading arrow symbol (keep the symbol). Undo the last change.

redo.description: Top-bar button with a leading arrow symbol (keep the symbol). Redo an undone change.

undoTitle.description: Tooltip of the undo button, including the keyboard shortcut. Use the local name of the Ctrl key.

redoTitle.description: Tooltip of the redo button, including the keyboard shortcuts. Use the local name of the Ctrl key.

lc.description: Checkbox label. When ticked, newly added frontmatter field names are written in lowercase. "Keys" means the field names.

lcTitle.message: Create new field names in lowercase (tags: instead of Tags:)
lcTitle.description: Tooltip of the lowercase checkbox. "tags:" and "Tags:" are literal examples of metadata keys; do not translate them.

addField.description: Button that opens the add-field menu. Keep the leading "+".

keyPh.description: Placeholder in the text box for typing a new frontmatter field name. "Enter" refers to the Enter key.

preview.description: Toolbar button that shows or hides the rendered Markdown preview next to the editor.

tbPreview.message: Show or hide the rendered preview (links open in a new tab; local images need a project folder)
tbPreview.description: Tooltip of the preview toolbar button.

previewTruncated.message: Preview shortened: the document is very long.
previewTruncated.description: Note at the end of the preview when only the first part of a very long document is rendered.

mediaFolder.description: Toolbar button that connects the Pelican project (site) folder, the one containing pelicanconf.py, so local images can be shown in the preview.

mediaFolderTip.message: Choose your Pelican project folder (the one with pelicanconf.py and the content folder) so images in the preview can be shown. Files are only read, never uploaded or changed.
mediaFolderTip.description: Tooltip of the project folder button when no folder is connected. pelicanconf.py is a file name: do not translate it.

mediaConnected.description: Button label when a project folder is connected. $NAME$ is the folder name.

mediaChange.message: Project folder connected. Click to choose a different folder.
mediaChange.description: Tooltip of the project folder button when a folder is connected.

mediaReconnect.description: Button label when the browser needs permission for the stored project folder again.

mediaReconnectTip.message: The browser asks for permission again after a restart. One click is enough.

mediaOff.description: Tooltip of the small button that disconnects the project folder.

mediaDir.message: Content folder inside the project folder (Pelican setting PATH, usually content)
mediaDir.description: Tooltip and label of the text box with the content folder name. PATH is the name of a Pelican setting: do not translate it.

mediaDirBad.message: Folder not found in the project folder: $NAME$
mediaDirBad.description: Error when the content folder name does not exist in the project folder. $NAME$ is the folder name that was typed.

mediaUnsupported.message: The project folder (image preview) works in Chrome and Edge only
mediaUnsupported.description: Tooltip of the disabled project folder button in browsers without folder access.

mediaNotFound.description: Tooltip on an image placeholder when the file does not exist in the media folder. $PATH$ is the path below the content folder.

mediaTooBig.description: Tooltip on an image placeholder when the file is too large to show. $PATH$ is the path below the content folder.

mediaBroken.description: Tooltip on an image placeholder when the file exists but is not a valid image. $PATH$ is the path below the content folder.

mediaOutside.message: Not inside the content folder, so no path can be built: $NAME$
mediaOutside.description: Status message when a chosen image is outside the content folder. $NAME$ is the file name.

mediaFailed.description: Start of an error message. The system error text is appended directly after it, so keep the trailing colon and space.

strayWarn.message: Line $LINE$ is not metadata, so the frontmatter ends before it and the rest is body text: “$TEXT$”. Metadata lines must look like “Key: value”; continuation lines need 4 spaces.
strayWarn.description: Warning under the frontmatter form when a non-blank line that is not a valid metadata line ends the header. $LINE$ is the line number, $TEXT$ the start of that line. “Key: value” is a literal example; keep the 4 spaces rule.

emptyHint.message: No frontmatter yet. Add one with “+ Field” or type tags: at the start of the text on the right.
emptyHint.description: Hint shown when the document has no frontmatter yet. Contains the HTML tag … around the literal text "tags:"; keep the tag and do not translate "tags:". The quoted button name must match the translation of addField.

edPh.message: Type Markdown here, or open / drop a file …
edPh.description: Placeholder of the empty Markdown editor.

untitled.description: File name of a new, unsaved document. Keep the .md extension.

today.description: Quick-fill button on Date/Modified fields: inserts today's date (YYYY-MM-DD). Very short.

fromTitle.description: Quick-fill button on the Slug field: generates the slug from the Title field. Short. "Title" is the literal field name.

removeField.description: Tooltip of the × button that removes a frontmatter field.

closeTab.description: Tooltip of the × button on a tab.

newTab.description: Tooltip of the + button after the last tab.

confirmClose.description: Confirmation dialog when closing a tab that has unsaved changes. $NAME$ is replaced by the file name.

noTitle.description: Status message: generating a slug needs a Title field with content. "Title" is the literal field name.

badKey.description: Status message: the entered field name has forbidden characters (allowed: letters, digits, underscore, hyphen).

keyExists.description: Status message: a field with that name already exists, so the existing one is focused.

openFailed.description: Start of an error message. The system error text is appended directly after it, so keep the trailing colon and space.

saveFailed.description: Start of an error message. The system error text is appended directly after it, so keep the trailing colon and space.

saved.description: Short status message after saving to the file.

downloaded.description: Short status message after the file was downloaded (browsers without direct save).

tbBold.description: Tooltip of the bold button, including the keyboard shortcut.

tbItalic.description: Tooltip of the italic button, including the keyboard shortcut.

tbLink.description: Tooltip of the insert-link button, including the keyboard shortcut.

phText.description: Placeholder text inserted when formatting with nothing selected (e.g. between the ** of bold). Short, one word.

phAlt.description: Placeholder for the alternative text of an inserted image. Short.

langName.description: Name of this language written in that language itself (endonym), shown in the language drop-down. Examples: Deutsch, English, Français.

langTitle.description: Tooltip of the language drop-down in the top bar.

frontmatter.description: Heading of the side panel that lists the metadata fields at the top of the file. "Frontmatter" is the technical term; translate only if a common local term exists.

textDirection.description: Text direction of this language. Enter exactly "ltr" (left-to-right) or "rtl" (right-to-left). Not a sentence.

loadLang.description: Last entry of the language drop-down. Opens a file dialog to load a translation file (JSON) without rebuilding the app.

packLoaded.description: Status message after a language file was loaded. $LANG$ is replaced by the language name.

packInvalid.description: Error status message: the chosen file is not a usable translation file.

packCodePrompt.message: Language code for this file (e.g. fr or pt-BR):
packCodePrompt.description: Prompt asking for the language code of a loaded translation file. Keep the examples (fr, pt-BR).

imgDir.description: Toolbar button that chooses the folder with the images, inside the project folder. The image button opens its file picker there.

imgDirTip.message: Choose the folder with your images (inside the project folder). The image button starts there.
imgDirTip.description: Tooltip of the media folder button when none is chosen.

imgDirSet.description: Button label when a media folder is chosen. $PATH$ is its path inside the project folder, e.g. content/images.

imgDirChange.message: Media folder: $PATH$. Click to choose a different one.
imgDirChange.description: Tooltip of the media folder button when one is chosen. $PATH$ is its path inside the project folder.

imgDirOutside.message: The media folder must be inside the project folder
imgDirOutside.description: Status message when the chosen media folder is not inside the project folder.
